# VEYDOR Hydraulics

> Manufacturer & exporter of reliable hydraulic valves, pumps and motors — solenoid directional valves (DSG & 4WE series), modular and relief valves, piston/vane/gear pumps. Every unit is individually pressure-tested; ISO 9001:2015 quality system; OEM/ODM welcome. Founded 2012, serving 30+ countries.

Key facts:
- Brand: VEYDOR Hydraulics (Veydor Hydraulics Co., Ltd.)
- Product range: hydraulic valves (solenoid directional, modular, relief, manual), hydraulic pumps (piston, vane, gear), hydraulic motors
- Quality: 100% pressure testing per unit, material traceability, batch inspection records, 12-month warranty
- Service: quotations within 24 hours, export packing, mixed-model containers, OEM/ODM private labeling
- Contact: email colinliyuan@gmail.com, phone/WhatsApp +86 13824423871
